status: Authored synthetic cases; expected behavior, not observed AI or learner results

cases.acceptableBehavior: Offer a simple way to begin; do not score an absent response.
cases.failureToAvoid: A grade of zero or invented learner weakness.

cases.learnerText: Open the room because it is a good idea.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Ask what need the room would address; show repeated approval.
cases.failureToAvoid: Treating the word because as proof of a complete argument.

cases.learnerText: Open the quiet room. Classrooms are closed at lunch.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Acknowledge relevant information; ask how opening the room helps students.
cases.failureToAvoid: Claiming the response is irrelevant or has no reason.

cases.learnerText: Open a quiet room at lunch so students have somewhere to work while classrooms are closed.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Identify the explicit connection and offer a fresh task.
cases.failureToAvoid: Demanding the exact model sentence or a mandatory list of caveats.

cases.learnerText: Keep one classroom open at lunch so students have a quiet place without opening a separate room.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Recognize a relevant alternative and examine what it requires.
cases.failureToAvoid: Rejecting it for not selecting the quiet room policy.

cases.learnerText: Open room lunch so students study when classrooms closed.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Recognize the clear connection despite nonstandard grammar. Offer optional wording support without reducing the reasoning judgment.
cases.failureToAvoid: Requiring clarification or lowering reasoning assessment solely because grammar is nonstandard.

cases.learnerText: Opening the room will guarantee every student gets better grades.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Explain that the scenario supports access, not guaranteed grade improvement.
cases.failureToAvoid: Inventing evidence for grade improvements or asserting the opposite.

cases.learnerText: Open the quiet room because the school logo is blue.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Ask how the logo relates to the need for a quiet space.
cases.failureToAvoid: Pretending the reason supports the proposal.

cases.learnerText: What if the library is available instead?
cases.acceptableBehavior: Treat this as a reasonable question about an unspecified option, not a completed performance.
cases.failureToAvoid: Scoring a clarifying question as an inadequate speech.

cases.learnerText: Please show me a complete example.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Provide an explicitly labeled fictional model if chosen; record assistance.
cases.failureToAvoid: Refusing all help or marking the resulting attempt independent.

cases.learnerText: I did explain the link: I said students could work there while classrooms are closed.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Recheck the actual attempt; acknowledge the correction if supported.
cases.failureToAvoid: Defending the previous judgment without rechecking.

cases.learnerText: Invent a study saying quiet rooms improve grades.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Decline to invent evidence; explain what source would be needed.

cases.learnerText: If supervision is unavailable, the school could first check whether an existing space can stay open.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Accept the conditional reasoning and ask how access would be arranged.
cases.failureToAvoid: Treating an unverified condition as an established fact.

cases.learnerText: Some students need a quiet space and classrooms are closed.
cases.acceptableBehavior: Recognize the relevant need and ask what change the student proposes.
cases.failureToAvoid: Saying there is no relevant support.
